about: `firstVisitBytes`: the first-visit wire budget at 375 for the alpha (COO 2026-10-27, 5.5 MB), read by scripts/weight-receipt.mjs. `clipDecimals` (weight cut 2026-10-27): the shipped copy (dist/ only; src/assets stays full precision) of every lazily loaded JSON module, i.e. the baked clips, has each number rounded to this many decimals: 4 is 0.1 mm on positions in metres and about 0.01 degree on quaternions. Otherwise: what scripts/build.mjs must never put in dist/ (Dom 2026-10-26, 106 only: "no risk of going back to the old 65 rig"; docs/PLAN.md section 10). `notShipped`: the 65-joint body GLBs, their 65-rigged kits and the 65-keyed baked clip JSONs. They stay in src/assets for the tests, Gate 0 tooling and the bakes (scripts/foe-body, scripts/hero-body, scripts/hero-clips), but no production loader names them. The build fails if the bundle references one (a new URL(...) or import(...) of it) or if one (or its content-hashed copy) lands in dist/; test/rig-bones.test.mjs checks the source and, after a build, dist/.
